title: TRICARE Select Cost Share by Provider Network Relationship on Lines Reprocessed for Other Health Insurance
content:
**Standing rule.** Where the provider was not in the network on the service date, the cost share on a **TRICARE Select** line reprocessed for other health insurance is the tier's non-network outpatient percentage of the amount left once the deductible is taken off, rounded to the cent; where the provider was in the network and the line is durable medical equipment, it is the tier's network durable medical equipment percentage of the amount left, rounded to the cent; where the provider was in the network and the line is preventive care or the tier's network basis is fixed copayment, it is the tier's network copayment for the line's service class, never more than the amount left; otherwise it is the tier's network outpatient percentage of the amount left, rounded to the cent.

The network relationship and service class are those recorded on the reversed line.

## Tier figures (percent of the amount left)

| Tier | Network basis | Network outpatient | Non-network outpatient | Network durable medical equipment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4) | percent of allowed | 15 | 20 | 15 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-5 and Above) | percent of allowed | 15 | 20 | 15 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-1 to E-4) | fixed copayment | 0 | 20 | 10 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-5 and Above) | fixed copayment | 0 | 20 | 10 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A | percent of allowed | 20 | 25 | 20 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B | fixed copayment | 0 | 25 | 20 |

Network copayments are those of the TRICARE Select network copayment schedule for the tier and service class.

## Input - judgement - output (hypothetical, amount left 80.00)

- Non-network provider, TRICARE Select Retiree Group A: 25 percent, 20.00.
- Network durable medical equipment, TRICARE Select Retiree Group B: 20 percent, 16.00.
- Network urgent care visit, TRICARE Select Retiree Group B: copayment 38.00.
- Network ambulatory surgery, TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, amount left 80.00: copayment 145.00 exceeds 80.00, so 80.00.
- Network primary care visit, TRICARE Select Retiree Group A: 20 percent, 16.00.
